task: Create an AWS Lambda function that extracts the AWS account ID from an ARN string
solution_criteria: Must parse ARN format (arn:aws:service:region:account-id:resource), extract and return the account ID, include proper error handling, and be suitable for Lambda with runtime Python 3.11, memory 128MB, and 30-second timeout

task: Generate a CloudFormation template JSON configuration for an S3 bucket with versioning enabled and public access blocked
solution_criteria: Must define S3 bucket resource with VersioningConfiguration and PublicAccessBlockConfiguration properties, include proper AWS CloudFormation syntax, and be valid JSON that can be deployed directly

task: Create a regex pattern to validate AWS IAM role names according to AWS naming conventions
solution_criteria: Must match valid IAM role names (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, 1-64 characters), reject invalid characters, and work with common regex engines used in Python and validation tools
